name: tome-of-abyssal-heaven-other-weapon-has-spellshroud-tome-itself-targetable
notes: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: "Other objects you control have spellshroud" -- shrouds the other weapon, not itself. Tome of Abyssal Heaven (igmC01eEZn, REGALIA/ITEM): "Other objects you control have spellshroud." -- an unconditional static grant; it was not implemented anywhere (no HasSpellshroud() clause). Fixed: HasSpellshroud() returns true for any field object whose controller controls an ability-bearing Tome (other than the Tome itself). Player 2 controls the Tome and a Mirrordepth's Blade; player 1 plays Fracturize: the target prompt offers ONLY the Tome (theirField-1) -- the Blade (theirField-2) is shrouded and answering with it is refused -- and the Tome, which only grants spellshroud to OTHER objects, is a legal target and becomes a phantasia.

rulesClauses: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: other objects you control have spellshroud (the Tome itself does not).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Tome of Abyssal Heaven's static "Other objects you control have spellshroud." was not implemented anywhere (no clause in HasSpellshroud()). Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- the other object was offered. Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for any field object whose controller controls an ability-bearing Tome (excluding the Tome itself), after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates. Break/restore: reverting Custom/GameLogic.php to HEAD~1 (48faaae9) fails this fixture (Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded; this fixture requires rejection); restoring the fix (shasum 0ae48c678ba109f3cbd835f3b409cbd37d44a11c) passes. Full-suite revert: 22 of the 28 new fixtures fail (1011/1033), the 6 negative controls / pins pass either way. Mutation check: dropping the '$tomeObj !== $obj' self-exclusion fails only this fixture (the Tome would shroud itself); dropping the HasNoAbilities($tomeObj) gate fails only tome-of-abyssal-heaven-lost-abilities-grants-nothing (1032/1033 each).
